ssl.augmentation: one shared current-scan rotation around vertical Z; no labels or future scan
ssl.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no validation/test SSL loss or labels
ssl.p2_initialization: official checkpoint when available, otherwise explicitly train-only Sugar4D from scratch; never conflate settings

downstream.count_head: single linear layer on mean/max patch tokens plus train-standardized current XYZ geometry
downstream.count_loss: MSE on train-label-standardized count; clip predictions to nonnegative, no rounding
downstream.count_selection: minimum validation plant-macro MAE, ties earliest epoch
downstream.segmentation_selection: maximum validation mean of per-plant three-class mIoU, ties earliest epoch
downstream.segmentation_head: inverse-distance three-nearest patch-token interpolation plus normalized current XYZ and local offset; pointwise MLP
downstream.class_weight: train-labelled-plant point frequencies, inverse sqrt, capped at 10, mean normalized

primary.condition: 100% labelled plants, full fine-tuning, official validation
primary.comparison: P2 versus P0 with identical backbone/head/label subset/seed/budget

test_policy: no test inference in this run; all previous M3.5 official/fold test results remain exploratory and are not read for M4 decisions
geometry_policy: only current full-scan XYZ descriptors; sampled points centered by current full-scan mean and divided by current full-scan radius; center/radius/raw extent saved, no future transforms
budget_policy: 20-epoch feasibility budget is not a reproduction of official 500-epoch ShapeNet training; no adaptive extension based on validation/test results
decision: REPRESENTATION-SUCCESS only if all primary rules and geometry-baseline rule pass, no leakage/collapse and primary matrix complete. REPRESENTATION-PIVOT only if simpler baselines dominate both count and segmentation and pretraining does not improve either; otherwise LIMITED-BENEFIT. Missing experiments cannot establish scientific success or engineering PASS.
